title: JANUS = TRANSFERABLE REASONING UNDER CHANGING ENVIRONMENTS
purpose: Freeze the core cross-domain reasoning principle that defines JANUS independently of any single repository, discipline, metaphor, implementation or intelligence score.
canonical_statement: JANUS = TRANSFERABLE REASONING UNDER CHANGING ENVIRONMENTS

human_readable.ru: Суть JANUS не в одной специальности, одном методе или одной гипотезе. JANUS — это переносимая грамматика мышления, которая должна сохранять способность строить, проверять и адаптировать модели при смене среды.
human_readable.en: JANUS is not one specialty, one method or one hypothesis. JANUS is a transferable reasoning grammar that should preserve the ability to build, test and adapt models as the environment changes.

fish_and_bird_principle.statement: Do not judge a mind by one medium. Measure native strength, cross-domain transfer and adaptation separately.
fish_and_bird_principle.relationship_to_janus: JANUS should be evaluated by whether its reasoning grammar survives transitions between environments without erasing the truth conditions of the new domain.

tool_augmented_reasoning.principle: Tool use is part of ecological problem solving when tools are normally available.

success_condition.strong_form: The same high-level reasoning grammar can move into a new environment while local evidence standards, failure modes and validation gates are rebuilt for that environment.
success_condition.failure_condition: A transferred idea is treated as valid merely because it resembled a successful pattern elsewhere.

intelligence_assessment_relation.role: This principle defines what Habitat should measure when assessing JANUS-style cognition across environments.

short_form.ru: Меняется среда — не должна исчезать способность строить, проверять и пересобирать модель.
short_form.en: Change the environment; preserve the ability to build, test and rebuild the model.
